items.description: Finding ways to document both component and execution attributes for AI bill of materials (AI BOM).

items.title: Google API Keys Remain Active After Deletion
items.description: A security researcher discovered the API keys can still be used for up to 23 minutes after deletion, even though the cloud provider claims deletion is immediate.

items.title: Hackers Use Fake Microsoft Teams Downloads to Deploy ValleyRAT Malware
items.description: Hackers have been caught running a deceptive campaign that uses fake Microsoft Teams download websites to trick users into installing ValleyRAT, a remote access trojan capable of stealing data, logging keystrokes, and taking remote control of infected machines. items.title: Fake Invitation Phishing Campaign Targets U.S. Organizations With Credential Theft
